messages:
tanya (Eng): Hey @people-ops — quick heads up: we just got a likely foster-to-adopt placement call for next week. I need to understand leave options and paperwork timeline. Can paid parental leave be used for foster placements that are expected to convert to adoption? Also need cover for ~4 weeks for oncall + PR merges. tagging @dan for manager approval.

dan (Manager): We can shift priorities. On the coverage side, agree we should get a short-term contractor for 4–6 weeks. Tanya — do you have the precise dates yet? If not, manager OK in principle, will confirm budget.

lee (People Ops): Congrats, Tanya! Short answers: 1) Yes — our paid parental leave policy covers foster placements that are placed with intent to adopt. 2) We need an official placement letter from the agency + a signed Workday leave request to start processing. 3) If placement is temporary and not intended for adoption, different rules may apply (FMLA/unpaid). I'll DM the placement checklist and fast-track. :tada:

michelle (Payroll): For payroll to process paid parental leave we need: placement date, agency placement letter (scan/photo ok), and your signed leave form in Workday. If this is coming quickly, email scanned docs to payroll@redwood.com and put "FOSTER-PLACEMENT URGENT" in the subject so we flag it. We can retro-pay within the policy window if docs arrive after leave starts.

tanya (Eng): Thanks — super helpful. About the contractor: @dan is the manager OK to approve up to $10k for short-term coverage while I ramp down? Also any recommended partial-ramp cadence advice?

sam (Eng Ops): @dan we can onboard a contractor within 48–72h once approved; need manager signoff + PO. We can map them to oncall rotation and PR queue. Recommend adding explicit acceptance criteria in the vendor request to keep ramp smooth.

dan (Manager): Approve up to $10k for the contractor. Sam — please open the vendor request and copy People Ops for badge/access. Tanya — we'll handle the sprint triage and shift noncritical work off you.

lee (People Ops): Adding the quick checklist here: `placement_letter` (agency), `workday_leave_request` (select "Parental - Adoption/Foster"), manager approval email, scanned docs to payroll@redwood.com, and optional "family leave top-up" request if you want salary beyond base paid leave. I'll email the `placement_checklist.pdf` and can run a 15-min call this afternoon to help you fill forms.

michelle (Payroll): Recommend schedule: 60% capacity first 2 weeks (partial blocks for async work) then reassess. Add a calendar note "partial leave" for clear handoffs; we will adjust payroll entries to match the leave dates you submit.

tanya (Eng): Got it — sending scans now and will book the 15-min call. Appreciate everyone moving quickly.

lee (People Ops): Ping sent — we'll take it from here. If anything changes (dates or agency contact), drop it in this thread or DM me. :heart:
